probe.result: passed: 1000 legacy users; 500 new wallets once; stable identifiers/indexes across key reorder; input isolation and repeat fixed point; ambiguous active matches rejected; 512 rating cases, 96 stake cases and insufficient-balance controls, 12 spread boundaries and tie/order/filter controls

limitations: Only six full-read files count, 601 lines; facade/store/core queues already reviewed elsewhere. Runtime seed use, commerce reservation, matchmaking bot-fill and test registration were supporting reads; full account/commerce/matchmaking/platform API integration still pending.

Pure synthetic-memory function probes, no actual data migrations, runtime startup, external network, Cocos build, changes to bot/game behavior or deployment. Fixed-point tests cover valid historical data, not every malformed schema.

Rating mathematical invariants do not prove statistical fairness, calibrated win probabilities or optimum pairing. Real public waiting also invokes bot fill, so widened standalone selector is not claimed as current user waiting duration.

Seeded platform defaults still include historical sample products/tournaments and an active no-expiry integration season. Existing operated records win migration; end-to-end reachability/retirement and production override configuration remain pending boundary work, not a new confirmed defect or deletion authorization.
